"""Pure offline hash, XML, query-boundary and identity replay."""
import hashlib, json, pathlib, sys
from derive_offline import derive
root = pathlib.Path(__file__).resolve().parent.parent.parent
path = pathlib.Path(sys.argv[1]) if len(sys.argv)>1 else root/'reports/cc12_audio_endpoint_publication_diagnostics.json'
receipt = json.loads(path.read_text())
count = 0; unique = set()
def walk(value):
    global count
    if isinstance(value, dict):
        retained = value.get('retained_path', '').replace('\\', '/')
        if retained.startswith('local/cc12_audio_endpoint_publication_diagnostics/frozen/') and 'sha256' in value:
            data = (root/retained).read_bytes()
            assert len(data) == value['bytes'] and hashlib.sha256(data).hexdigest() == value['sha256'], value
            count += 1; unique.add(retained)
        for child in value.values(): walk(child)
    elif isinstance(value, list):
        for child in value: walk(child)
walk(receipt)
def load(pin): return json.loads((root/pin['retained_path']).read_text(encoding='utf-8-sig'))
events = load(receipt['complete_frozen_raw']['events'])
services = load(receipt['complete_frozen_raw']['service_configuration'])
registration = load(receipt['prior_registration']['complete_receipt_pin'])
spec = load(receipt['complete_frozen_raw']['event_query_spec'])
assert derive(events, services, registration) == receipt['derived_evidence']
assert [(q['query_id'], q['log'], q['xpath']) for q in events['queries']] == [(q['id'], q['log'], q['xpath']) for q in spec['queries']]
assert all(q['log'].startswith(('Microsoft-Windows-Audio/', 'Microsoft-Windows-Kernel-PnP/')) for q in spec['queries'])
assert all('EventData[' in q['xpath'] for q in spec['queries'] if 'Kernel-PnP' in q['log'])
assert services['audio_class_definitions'][0]['values']['Class'] == 'MEDIA'
assert services['audio_class_definitions'][1]['values']['Class'] == 'AudioEndpoint'
assert [d['guid'] for d in services['audio_class_definitions']] == spec['audio_class_guid_values']
assert registration['current_MMDevice_all_state']['native_result']['AllStateRenderCount'] == 0
assert receipt['derived_evidence']['unique_event_count'] == 5
assert receipt['derived_evidence']['events_matching_retained_current_audio_identities'] == 0
assert receipt['derived_evidence']['events_by_level_name'] == {'Information': 5}
assert all(d['state'] == 'Running' and d['service_exit_code'] == 0 and d['specific_exit_code'] == 0 for d in receipt['derived_evidence']['services'])
for row in services['services']:
    pin = next(p for p in receipt['configured_service_DLL_frozen_pins'] if p['path'] == row['service_dll']['path'])
    assert pin['bytes'] == row['service_dll']['bytes'] and pin['sha256'] == row['service_dll']['sha256']
assert receipt['finding']['direct_cause_identified'] is False and receipt['finding']['supported_mutation_proposal'] is None
assert receipt['git']['prior_registration_receipt_unchanged']
print(json.dumps({'result': 'pass', 'scope': 'Pure offline retained file hashes/raw XML/typed identity and bounded query replay; no OS, service, event-log, SDK, compiler, GPR or game calls',
    'retained_pin_occurrences_verified': count, 'unique_retained_files_verified': len(unique),
    'unique_informational_events_replayed': 5, 'exact_current_audio_identity_matches': 0,
    'configured_service_DLL_hashes_verified': 2, 'unsupported_cause_or_action_not_asserted': True}, indent=2))
